title: Annual Leave Policy
text: Full-time employees accrue annual leave according to their employment contract. Leave requests should be submitted through the HR portal before the planned absence. Manager approval is required before leave is considered confirmed. Emergency leave should be reported to the manager as soon as practical.

title: Sick Leave and Medical Absence
text: Employees who cannot work because of illness should notify their manager as soon as possible. A medical certificate may be requested for extended absences according to local law and the employee's contract. Personal medical details should be shared only with authorized HR personnel.

title: Business Expense Reimbursement
text: Employees must submit business expense claims with itemized receipts within 30 calendar days of the purchase. Claims require manager approval and must follow the approved travel and expense limits. Personal expenses are not reimbursable.

title: Information Security and Data Handling
text: Employees must use approved company systems to store confidential information. Passwords and access tokens must not be shared. Suspected data exposure or phishing must be reported to the security team immediately. Access should be limited to the minimum required for the job.

title: Remote Work Policy
text: Remote work eligibility depends on role requirements and manager approval. Employees should be reachable during agreed working hours and protect confidential information when working outside the office. This policy does not override local employment agreements.

title: Workplace Conduct and Reporting
text: Employees should treat colleagues respectfully and report harassment, discrimination, or retaliation to HR or the designated reporting channel. Reports are handled according to company procedures and applicable law. Retaliation against someone making a good-faith report is prohibited.

title: Employee Onboarding Checklist
text: New employees must complete required security training, review the employee handbook, set up multi-factor authentication, and confirm payroll details during onboarding. Managers should check completion of required training within the first week.

title: Business Travel Approval
text: Business travel must be approved by the employee's manager before bookings are made. Employees should use approved booking channels and follow the expense reimbursement policy. Exceptions require documented approval.
